name: PT Astra Otoparts Tbk
summary: PT Astra Otoparts Tbk manufactures, sells, distributes, and exports spare parts for two-wheelers and four-wheelers in Indonesia, the Rest of Asia, the Middle East, the United States, Europe, and Africa. It operates through the Trading and Automotive Component Manufacturing segments.
